HelpPage.DESCRIPTION: Find answers, explore the documentation, and get in touch with the support team.

HelpPage.FAQ_DESCRIPTION: Answers to the most common integration and account questions.
HelpPage.FAQ_1_Q: How do I authenticate API requests?
HelpPage.FAQ_1_A: Pass your API key in the x-api-key header on every request. You can create or rotate keys from the API Keys page in your dashboard.
HelpPage.FAQ_2_Q: What happens when I reach my monthly request limit?
HelpPage.FAQ_2_A: Requests beyond your plan's monthly limit will return a 429 Too Many Requests response. Upgrade your plan or wait for the next billing cycle to resume access.
HelpPage.FAQ_3_Q: Can I use a sandbox key for testing?
HelpPage.FAQ_3_A: Yes. Create a key named 'Sandbox' (or similar) and use it in your test environment. Sandbox requests count against the same monthly quota as live requests.
HelpPage.FAQ_4_Q: How do I change the country or tax year for a calculation?
HelpPage.FAQ_4_A: Pass the countryCode and taxYear fields in your request body. See the API Reference for the full list of supported countries and years per calculator.
HelpPage.CONTACT_SUPPORT_DESCRIPTION: Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out and we'll get back to you.

IncomeTaxCalculator.TITLE: Income Tax Calculator
IncomeTaxCalculator.INCOME_TAX_LEARN_MORE: Learn more about this country's income tax calculations
IncomeTaxCalculator.INCOME_TAX_DESCRIPTION: Instantly calculate your income tax liability across multiple countries. See detailed breakdowns by tax bracket and understand your effective tax rate.
IncomeTaxCalculator.ENTER_INCOME: Enter an income to see your tax breakdown
IncomeTaxCalculator.PROGRESSIVE_TAX_SYSTEM_DESC: Most countries use a progressive tax system where higher income is taxed at higher rates. Our calculator breaks down exactly how much you pay in each bracket.
IncomeTaxCalculator.STANDARD_DEDUCTIONS_DESC: We automatically apply standard deductions where applicable. For example, the US has a $14,600 standard deduction for single filers in 2024.
IncomeTaxCalculator.EFFECTIVE_VS_MARGINAL_RATE_DESC: Your effective tax rate is the actual percentage of income you pay in taxes, which is typically lower than your marginal (highest bracket) rate.

MortgageCalculator.TITLE: Mortgage Calculator
MortgageCalculator.DESCRIPTION: Plan your home purchase with detailed mortgage calculations. Compare monthly payments, view amortization schedules, and understand the total cost of your loan.
MortgageCalculator.UNDERSTANDING_YOUR_PAYMENT_DESC: Your monthly mortgage payment includes principal, interest, property taxes, and insurance (PITI). Our calculator breaks down each component to give you a complete picture.
MortgageCalculator.PRIVATE_MORTGAGE_INSURANCE_DESC: In some countries, if your down payment is less than 20%, lenders typically require PMI. This protects the lender if you default on your loan. PMI can be removed once you reach 20% equity.
MortgageCalculator.AMORTIZATION_EXPLAINED_DESC: Early in your loan, most of your payment goes toward interest. Over time, more goes toward principal. Our amortization schedule shows exactly how your loan balance decreases.

CorporateTaxCalculator.DEDUCTIONS_AND_CREDITS_DESC: Businesses can reduce taxable income through deductions like operating expenses, depreciation, and R&D credits. We factor in common deductions based on your country's tax code.
CorporateTaxCalculator.EFFECTIVE_VS_STATUTORY_RATE_DESC: The statutory rate is the official tax rate, while the effective rate is what you actually pay after deductions and credits. Understanding both helps with financial planning.

CorporateTaxCalculator.HOW_CORPORATE_TAX_IS_CALCULATED_DESC: Corporate tax is computed based on taxable income after deductions, allowances, and applicable credits.

CapitalGainsTaxCalculator.TITLE: Capital Gains Tax Calculator
CapitalGainsTaxCalculator.DESCRIPTION: Calculate your capital gains tax liability for asset sales across multiple countries. Understand tax rates, exemptions, and effective tax rates.
CapitalGainsTaxCalculator.ENTER_INCOME: Enter an income to see your tax breakdown

CapitalGainsTaxCalculator.SHORT_TERM_VS_LONG_TERM_DESC: Most countries offer preferential tax rates for assets held longer than a specific period. In the US, holding investments over 12 months qualifies for lower long-term capital gains rates.
CapitalGainsTaxCalculator.TAX_LOSS_HARVESTING_DESC: Capital losses can offset capital gains in many jurisdictions. Strategic selling of losing positions can reduce your overall tax liability and improve after-tax returns.
CapitalGainsTaxCalculator.ANNUAL_EXEMPTIONS_DESC: Some countries like the UK and Germany offer annual tax-free allowances on capital gains.

InheritanceTaxCalculator.RELATIONSHIP_MATTERS_DESC: Most countries offer higher tax-free allowances for close family members like spouses and children compared to distant relatives.
InheritanceTaxCalculator.RESIDENCE_RELIEF_DESC: Some countries like the UK offer additional relief when passing your main home to direct descendants, reducing the tax burden.
InheritanceTaxCalculator.ESTATE_PLANNING_DESC: Proper estate planning with trusts, gifts, and legal structures can significantly reduce inheritance tax liability.
InheritanceTaxCalculator.SPOUSAL_EXEMPTION_DESC: Transfers to spouses are typically fully exempt from inheritance tax in most jurisdictions, preserving family wealth.

AboutPage.HERO_DESCRIPTION: CalcGlobal is a financial calculation platform built for a world without borders. We give developers, accountants, and individuals accurate tax and financial tools for 50+ countries — in one place, in multiple languages.
AboutPage.MISSION_P1: Tax systems are among the most complex and opaque structures in modern society. People moving countries, businesses expanding globally, and investors diversifying across borders all face the same problem: getting reliable numbers is hard. CalcGlobal exists to change that — making accurate, up-to-date financial calculations accessible to anyone, anywhere.
AboutPage.VALUE1_DESC: We built CalcGlobal to work across 50+ countries from day one — not as an afterthought. Every calculator accounts for local tax laws, currency conventions, and regulatory nuances.
AboutPage.VALUE2_DESC: Our calculation engine delivers sub-100ms results with 99.99% uptime. Accuracy is non-negotiable: our models are reviewed and updated whenever tax laws change.
AboutPage.VALUE3_DESC: We are transparent about data practices, calculation assumptions, and limitations. We never sell your data and we always tell you when numbers are estimates.
AboutPage.VALUE4_DESC: Alongside our API, we host a marketplace of verified financial professionals who can review calculations and provide jurisdiction-specific advice.
AboutPage.STORY_P1: CalcGlobal started with a simple frustration: moving between countries and trying to understand how your tax burden changes. Existing tools were either country-specific, inaccurate, or buried inside paid accounting software.
AboutPage.STORY_P2: We built a calculation engine that treats every country as a first-class citizen — not an afterthought localisation. Today, our API powers fintech apps, accounting platforms, and HR tools that need reliable cross-border financial data.
AboutPage.STORY_P3: We are a small, remote-first team passionate about data accuracy, developer experience, and making complex financial systems understandable. We believe the best financial decisions come from having the right numbers.
AboutPage.CTA_P1: Have questions, partnership enquiries, or want to join our expert network?
